params.name: Crumbs
params.note: Blazor only: the trail is rendered as a pk-breadcrumb in the breadcrumb slot, one link per PkCrumb and aria-current on the last.

params.name: BreadcrumbLabel
params.note: Blazor only: the label of the pk-breadcrumb the crumbs are rendered into.

params.name: ShellSection
params.note: Blazor only: the SectionOutlet name in the layout that feeds the app shell's title slot; the title is written there and not drawn twice.

params.name: BackLink
params.note: Blazor only: draws a back link (a ghost pk-button with href and a chevron, named Back to <label>) to the last crumb before the current one that has an Href, before the title in the ShellSection outlet, or above the header without a shell section. Off by default.

notes: Hand-written: Title maps to heading and falls back to the last crumb's label; Level starts at 1; SuffixContent is the default slot (beside the title).
